qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed core banking software is sticky once deployed, but new win rates have decelerated, bespoke bank RFPs compress margins and pricing power, and aggressive R&D capitalization obscures underlying economic returns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power). While installed core banking software has high switching costs, new license win rates have stalled, banks exert heavy pricing pressure in bespoke RFPs, and aggressive R&D capitalization masks sub-hurdle true cash returns amidst competition from cloud-native fintech engines.
qualitative.evidence: Loss of market momentum in core banking migrations to cloud-native rivals (Thought Machine, Mambu). Substantial license earnings volatility, governance turnover, and reliance on R&D capitalization to sustain reported operating margins.
